clause.quote: Codes in the small Count Code table MUST be each four characters long.

description: After the genus/version code the stream holds only -JA, three characters of a four-character count code. The specification has no sentence saying such a stream must be rejected; the assertion rests on the cited MUST, which this stream violates, so it cannot be decoded as a conforming stream. Any rejection satisfies the assertion; the class in the note is informative.
title: Reject a stream that ends inside a small count code
